responsibility: Declares the gcc_targetcm structure that holds C-family target hooks and includes the generated hook fields from c-target.def. It is the public interface by which shared C-family code calls target-specific behaviors such as string-object support, preincluded headers, option handling, and C++ linkage tweaks.
same_name_distinction: Public header exposing the generated C-family target hook structure: it defines how c-target.def's DEFHOOK entries become fields of gcc_targetcm and declares the targetcm instance used by code such as c-format.cc, whereas c-target.def is the declarative hook list itself.
